summary: @servicetitan/data-query preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The published tarball for @servicetitan/data-query@41.3.2 contains two files at the tarball root — setup.mjs and math_init.js — that are not declared in package.json's files array (which lists only 'dist' and 'src'). package.json defines scripts.preinstall as 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip into a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes execFileSync on the Bun binary passing the local math_init.js as its argument. math_init.js is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file (@bun-cjs header, hex-named identifiers, string-array rotation via WV8StW, opaque numeric/string constant tables, dead-code control flow) that would be executed under Bun on every install. Fetching a second language runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated bundled payload, together with the fact that setup.mjs and math_init.js are undeclared in the manifest while the genuine library source lives under src/, is the alternate-runtime dropper shape: an alien runtime is used to execute smuggled code so Node-scoped scanners never evaluate it. This causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code execution on the installer's machine on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
